audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart carried a blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows while the content layer (and packet) hold Karma L1-4, Mel L5-7.
audit.why: Karma's early poke (Inner Flame matches Mel's 950 range, RQ Soulflare at 3, shields+W sustain) dominates pre-6; Mel's Golden Eclipse executes through Karma's shields and out-scales her utility kit. 47.45% WR fits an early-deficit, late-favored lane.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to match content win[] (Karma x4, Mel x3), whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place Karma's window at level 3-5 (Mantra Soulflare), Mel's at 6 (execute through shields) and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no digits; Do's/Don'ts bodies were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad; missing anti-heal note for Karma's Mantra-W heal; W-tether-vs-Rebuttal distinction not stated.
audit.why: Karma W is 12s flat, Q 9-5s, Mantra 40/38/36/34 but Gathering Fire refunds it on hits. Her W tether is unit-targeted, not a projectile — Mel's Rebuttal does not break it. Mantra-W heals her, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; bleed bullets replaced; tether-is-not-a-projectile stated in dontsFull[1].d; Oblivion Orb timing added to breakdown.mid.
